Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and suggested next steps:

- Recap: You’re evaluating inference for real-time recommendations (~200 qps peak, mixed short/long contexts), need predictable latency and lower per-token cost. Primary constraints: multi-region latency, SOC 2 evidence, and SSO.
- Asks: 1) Technical deep dive with engineering (runtime + quantization tradeoffs); 2) Contracting timeline (target pilot by early Sept); 3) Security questionnaire (Neha will help).

To make the technical deep dive easier across your EU/US teams, we usually propose a rotating demo slot cadence so the same stakeholders can join occasionally outside their normal business hours. Proposed rotating slots (pick one to start; we can alternate week-to-week):

Option A (US-friendly):
- Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 BST / 01:00 SGT (Wed)
Option B (EU-friendly):
- Wed 16:00 PT / 19:00 ET / 00:00 BST (Thu) / 07:00 SGT (Thu)
Option C (APAC-friendly morning for Dynatek APAC):
- Thu 22:00 PT / Fri 01:00 ET / Fri 06:00 BST / Fri 13:00 SGT

If you prefer, we can do a stable single time — but rotating usually helps get engineers across regions involved without repeatedly asking the same people to join late. I attached a 1-page demo agenda and included a Calendly link below for quick slot selection.

Proposed next steps:
1) Pick one of the options above (or suggest alternatives)
2) Confirm engineering attendees (Mark, any other engineers?)
3) Share any specific items you want covered in the deep dive (e.g., KV cache behavior, batching, quantization impact on accuracy)

Thanks — happy to set up a recurring rotating invite once you pick.
